sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which unit is best for measuring the weight of a single apple?
How many millilitres make half a litre?
If 24 students are divided equally into 4 teams, how many students are in each team?
A spider has 8 legs. How many legs do 5 spiders have in total?
Which of these capital letters has a vertical line of symmetry?
How many days are there in a leap year?
If a movie starts at 4:00 PM and ends at 6:30 PM, what is the total duration of the movie?
In a tally mark chart, a bundle of 4 vertical lines with one diagonal slash represents which number?
If one symbol of a car on a pictograph represents 10 cars, what do 3 car symbols represent?
Which of these months has exactly 30 days?
Maya buys 2 kg of potatoes and 500 g of onions. What is the total weight of the vegetables in grams? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: We know 1 kg is 1000 grams. So, 2 kg is 2000 grams. Adding the 500 grams of onions, the total weight is 2500 grams.

questions.question_text: A box contains 56 pencils. They need to be packed equally into 7 small packets. How many pencils go into each packet? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: To find the number of pencils per packet, we divide the total 56 pencils by 7. Each packet will contain exactly 8 pencils.

questions.question_text: What does a line of symmetry do to a given shape? Give one example of a symmetrical object in nature. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A line of symmetry divides a shape into two identical halves that perfectly match when folded. A butterfly is a great example of a symmetrical object.

questions.question_text: A school bus leaves the museum at 2:15 PM and reaches the school at 3:00 PM. How many minutes did the journey take? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Counting the time from 2:15 PM to 3:00 PM gives a period of 45 minutes. The return journey took exactly 45 minutes to complete.

questions.question_text: A pictograph shows 4 apple symbols for Monday. If one symbol equals 5 apples, how many apples were sold on Monday? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Since each symbol represents 5 apples, we multiply the 4 symbols by 5. A total of 20 apples were sold on Monday.

questions.question_text: A water tank holds 50 litres of water. A family uses 15 litres for bathing and 12 litres for washing clothes. How much water is used in total, and how much is left in the tank? [40-50 words]
questions.answer: The family uses 15 litres plus 12 litres, making a total of 27 litres of water used. To find what is left, we subtract 27 from the total 50 litres. The tank now has exactly 23 litres of water remaining.

questions.question_text: The Transport Museum is open for 6 days a week and closed on Mondays. If it stays open for 8 hours each day, how many hours does the museum stay open in one full week? [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Since the museum is closed on Mondays, it is open for exactly 6 days in a week. We multiply these 6 open days by the 8 hours it remains open each day. Therefore, the museum stays open for a total of 48 hours every week.

sections.section_name: Section D - Mathematical Expression & Data Analysis

questions.question_text: A zookeeper counted the animals and found 15 tigers, 20 leopards, and 10 elephants. Explain step-by-step how you would represent this data using tally marks for the leopards. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: To represent the 20 leopards using tally marks, I would draw groups of five. First, I draw four vertical lines and cross them with one diagonal slash to make a bundle of five. I will draw exactly four of these bundles, because four multiplied by five equals exactly twenty.

questions.question_text: Amit wants to pour 2 litres of juice into smaller glasses. Each glass can hold exactly 250 millilitres of juice. Explain the steps to find out how many glasses he can completely fill. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: First, we need to convert the 2 litres of juice into millilitres, which gives us 2000 millilitres. Since one glass holds 250 millilitres, we see how many times 250 fits into 2000. Four glasses make 1000 millilitres, so eight glasses will exactly hold 2000 millilitres of juice.
